hero.title: Confirmed flights + trains on site
hero.description: Lufthansa round trip via Munich and Bangkok (1,544.08 EUR, Economy Flex, confirmed). On site: TRA, THSR and buses.

cards.title: Outbound flight Luxembourg -> Taipei
cards.description: Confirmed. Economy Flex, 2 layovers (Munich, Bangkok), total duration 20h00.

sections.title: Itinerary
items: LH 2323: LUX 8:10pm -> MUC 9:15pm (Air Dolomiti, E195) - 1h05 transfer
LH 772: MUC 10:20pm -> BKK 1:45pm +1 (Lufthansa, A350-900) - 3h30 transfer
LH 9728: BKK 5:15pm -> TPE 10:10pm (Thai Airways, A321neo)
Arrival at Taoyuan Terminal 1

sections.title: Baggage
items: 1 personal item (max 40 x 30 x 15 cm)
1 cabin bag 8 kg (max 55 x 40 x 23 cm)
1 checked bag 23 kg
Seat reservation included

sections.title: Documents
items: Passport (valid 6 months beyond return)
Visa-free entry up to 90 days
Taiwan Arrival Card online before departure

cards.title: Return flight Taipei -> Luxembourg
cards.description: Confirmed. Sunday evening departure, Monday morning arrival in Luxembourg. Total duration 20h10.

sections.title: Itinerary
items: LH 9729: TPE 6:50pm -> BKK 9:35pm (Thai Airways, A350-900) - 1h20 transfer
LH 773: BKK 10:55pm -> MUC 5:15am +1 (Lufthansa, A350-900) - 2h40 transfer
LH 2316: MUC 7:55am -> LUX 9:00am (Lufthansa, A319)
Departure from Taoyuan Terminal 1

sections.title: To plan
items: Online check-in the day before
Be at Terminal 1 around 4:30pm

cards.title: Train Taipei -> Luodong
cards.description: TRA east coast line (~2h). Book ahead: it's a Saturday and the line sells out.

sections.title: Booking
items: TRA Yilan line: Taipei Main -> Luodong, ~2h on a Tze-Chiang / Puyuma
Tickets open 29 days before departure - book at opening for a Saturday
In the morning: THSR Taoyuan -> Taipei (~20 min) from the Alfar Hotel

cards.title: Luodong -> Wushi Port (Turtle Island)
cards.description: 30 min to 1h depending on the mode. Be at the meeting point by 12:20pm for a 1:00pm departure.

sections.title: Options
items: TRA Luodong -> Toucheng (~25 min) then taxi to the port (~10 min)
Direct taxi from Luodong (~40 min)
Meeting point: Lanyang Museum Wushi Station, 1st floor (Huaqi 168)

cards.title: Train Luodong -> Taipei -> Hsinchu
cards.description: Luodong -> Taipei (~2h), then TRA (~1h10, center to center) or THSR (~35 min + shuttle).

sections.title: Booking
items: TRA: tickets at the station or app, no need to book early
THSR: early bird tickets online (-10 to -35%) 28 days ahead
THSR: Hsinchu HSR station (Zhubei) is ~20 min from downtown

cards.title: Local transport
cards.description: EasyCard for everything: MRT, buses, TRA, YouBike and even convenience stores.

sections.title: On arrival
items: Buy an EasyCard at the airport (MRT or convenience store)
Airport MRT TPE -> Taipei Main: ~40 min, last departure ~11:35pm

sections.title: Taipei
items: Dense, easy MRT, everything in English
YouBike along the riverbanks

sections.title: Hsinchu and around
items: Downtown walkable from the SOL Hotel
Buses to Beipu, TRA Neiwan line for the valley
THSR for Taipei / Taichung day trips

cards.title: Hsinchu -> Taoyuan airport
cards.description: Allow ~1h travel, to time before the 6:50pm flight.

sections.title: Options
items: THSR Hsinchu HSR -> Taoyuan HSR (~12 min) then airport MRT (~20 min)
Or direct taxi Hsinchu -> TPE (~45 min, ~1200-1500 TWD)
Leave Hsinchu by 3pm at the latest
